text: Ask Robin whether he'd forward AI-transformation jobs he can't take
description: Robin now does AI-transformation work himself (Felix 2026-11-01). Start from appreciation for his work: ask whether he sometimes turns clients away (too much demand, or work that fits an agent loop better) and whether he'd like to forward such jobs, so his clients still get served and Felix/Aimparency gets real deliveries. Material ready to share once he's interested: the client-ready diagnostic offer (acb5797b) and the diagnostic/roadmap (fcb77ff3). Do not treat Robin as a source of contracts; the arrangement has to be useful to him and his clients.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A ready one-workflow offer lets a forwarded client say yes quickly. Uncertain: the price and terms were never tested with a real owner.
The diagnostic gives Robin a concrete picture of what a forwarded job would look like.

status.comment: Revived 2026-11-01 (cancelled before because the August call didn't happen). Next step for Felix: one message or call to Robin with the question above.
